title: The slow sync and query-log tests fit the Windows CI budget
goal: In the kb-tests-windows job no test runs past 300 s: the test_sync.py scenario fixture, test_querylog.py applied and the test_querylog_e2e.py scenario, which start child kbgit.py sync --push and query-log pipelines, take less time on Windows, and the job finishes inside its timeout.
notes: In kb-tests-windows job 16804081257 on the docker-windows runner (main c0ccafeb, --durations=15) no test runs past 300 s: the slowest are the setups of test_querylog_e2e.py TestAutonomousConverge 220 s, TestFixes 170 s, test_querylog.py TestApply 160 s and test_sync.py TestSyncInGit 148 s, and the whole suite takes 24 min. The sync scenarios clone the shared seed and the same-line conflict case runs as its own class. Half of TestFixes is one querylog.py apply in a fresh worktree: apply measures the whole eval set before and after each fix, so a further cut is a change to ql_apply, not the tests.
